report.title: Harvest Moon Bakery - Weekly Planning Meeting
report.attendees: Maria Lopez, Tom Becker, Priya Shah, Dev Patel
report.summary: The Harvest Moon Bakery team met on Tuesday, 6 October 2026, to discuss weekly planning and upcoming changes. A key decision was moving the Saturday opening time to 7:00 am starting in November. Several action items were assigned to Maria Lopez, Tom Becker, Priya Shah, and Dev Patel to handle pricing, inventory, labeling, and maintenance tasks. One open question remains regarding whether the bakery should start selling oat milk drinks.
